name: codex-long-horizon-skill
description: Local-first governance and evidence workflows for long-running engineering work, with static high-stakes capability discovery.

interface.shortDescription: Local-first governance, evidence, and bounded capability discovery.
interface.longDescription: Reusable local-first governance and evidence workflows for long-running engineering, safe resumption, validation, and static suggestion of descriptor-only high-stakes capability cards. No customer-data upload, account connection, domain execution, runtime authority, or automatic installation.
defaultPrompt: Use the long-horizon-engineering skill in guided customer mode. Start with intake, keep customer-sensitive material local, classify FACT, INFERENCE, and UNKNOWN, and propose exactly one next safe action for my decision.
Use the long-horizon-engineering skill. Explore the repository, plan the change, validate it, and stop before any unapproved external action.
Use the ai-video-production skill. Create a video brief, storyboard, shot list, asset manifest, and render handoff using placeholder assets.
